title: Sanction historical governance reconciliation for COMPAT-CAD-009
problem: COMPAT-CAD-009 has an immutable historical ordering defect: the APPROVED -> MERGED transition was timestamped 2026-09-06T12:07:25Z before the APPROVED decision recorded at 2026-09-06T12:08:00Z. The original events must remain unchanged and be reconciled explicitly rather than rewritten.
evidence: Governance validation run 34032828855 identified the CC009 temporal-ordering defect and the associated historical decision-order consequence.
The immutable CC009 governance record records transition #12 APPROVED -> MERGED at 2026-09-06T12:07:25Z and DEC-002 at 2026-09-06T12:08:00Z.
Physical product merge 066be5fc098443e21263ed57d21788849a875195 is confirmed by GitHub PR #14 and exact merge-triggered CI/browser evidence.
Existing ARCH-WF-002 reconciliation controls permit narrowly enumerated historical temporal-ordering defects without weakening evidence or revision-binding requirements.
impact: No architecture or validator semantics change. This ACR sanctions only an explicit historical temporal-ordering reconciliation for COMPAT-CAD-009 so the genuine physical merge and later approval recording order remain auditable without rewriting immutable events or weakening future lifecycle rules.
alternatives: Rewrite the historical merge or approval timestamps: rejected because that would falsify the audit trail.
Modify or weaken the validator to ignore this work item: rejected because it would reduce governance integrity.
Waive verification evidence requirements: rejected because post-merge evidence remains fully mandatory.
recommendation: Register ACR-006 through its normal PROPOSED -> ENDORSED -> APPROVED lifecycle, then maintain REC-COMPAT-CAD-009 as the explicit historical overlay for the temporal-ordering defect. Preserve all original transition and decision records and require the ordinary MERGED -> VERIFIED evidence gate.
migration_plan: Create this ACR as PROPOSED, advance it through the normal lifecycle to APPROVED, maintain REC-COMPAT-CAD-009 with the exact temporal-ordering defect citation, restore missing historical evidence EV-001 through EV-004 in CC009, retain exact post-merge evidence, and rerun governance validation.
compatibility: Architecture v1.1 remains frozen. The reconciliation affects only historical CC009 governance bookkeeping and does not change implementation scope, evidence policy, benchmark policy, or future lifecycle authorization rules.
security_impact: The ACR is repository-backed, role-restricted and auditable. It creates no bypass of implementation approval or verification controls and does not alter Git history.
provenance: Architect verification of the physical CC009 merge exposed an immutable bookkeeping-order defect; the existing ARCH-WF-002 reconciliation mechanism is the prescribed remedy.

review.rationale: The reconciliation is strictly historical and narrowly scoped to the observed timestamp-ordering defect.

approval.rationale: Product Owner approval authorizes only the explicitly enumerated historical reconciliation and preserves all normal verification gates.
